name: Utility Billing and Assistance Agent
headline: Resolve billing questions with evidence while keeping account authority human
summary: Bring synthetic balances, smart-meter history, leak-policy screening, payment options, and assistance criteria into one resident-service brief without changing a bill, plan, repair, enrollment, or account.
capabilities: Automate smart meter analysis for leak detection and usage anomalies
Apply municipal code rules to calculate credits and adjust bills
Screen income eligibility and pre-fill applications for assistance programs
Set up payment plans and schedule repairs in one efficient workflow
value: Improves consistency of usage and billing-evidence review.
Makes assistance and payment-plan criteria easier to explain.
Preserves resident and municipal controls by keeping every account action behind authorized staff approval.

notice.text: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
